title: Bingo Trailer
summary: An AI-generated trailer created in 2025 for BINGO, a proposed TV series developed as a pitch and proof of concept.
description:
An AI-generated trailer created in 2025 for BINGO, a proposed TV series developed as a pitch and proof of concept.

Set in the 1980s, the trailer establishes the series’ visual world through period-specific styling, wardrobe, environments, and cinematic direction.

I developed the trailer end-to-end, including concept development, creative direction, AI production, editing, post-production, and final delivery.

Created during an early stage of generative AI video production, the project demonstrates how AI could be used to visualize and pitch a series concept before full production.
